    last_seq = 0   # Sequence of the last valid record (0 for an empty prefix).

    while pos + _HEADER_SIZE <= total:
        payload_len, seq, kind, txid = unpack_header(log, pos)

        # An oversized payload declaration is an invalid header; a record whose
        # payload or CRC is cut short is incomplete.  Both end the valid prefix
        # right here.
        if payload_len > _MAX_PAYLOAD:

        end = body_end + _CRC_SIZE

        if crc32(view[pos:body_end]) != unpack_crc(log, body_end)[0]:

        # 0 therefore also rejects a zero sequence); the id must be positive.
